basis: The dashboard titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' displays four categories with explicit percentage shares that sum to 100%: Nuclear (45%), Fossil Fuels (30%), Renewables (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). The routing criterion is the 'Largest global energy consumption category'. Comparing the values, 45% is the largest share, identifying Nuclear as the target source. The task requires routing this source to priority monitoring. Option 1, 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring', is the only option that correctly maps the identified largest category to the required workflow.
option_label: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring
